user.title: Add SceneTV Android TV Bridge
user.description: Enter the local SceneTV bridge address.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Start pairing with this SceneTV launcher? The TV will show a code to enter next.

pair.title: Enter the code on the TV
pair.description: {name} shows a six character code. Enter it here to pair. The TV asks for nothing else.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored pairing token, usually because the Home Assistant pairing was revoked on the TV or the launcher was reinstalled. Submit to pair again; the TV will show a code if needed.

reconfigure.title: Change launcher address
reconfigure.description: Update the address if the TV got a new IP address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the launcher.
error.invalid_code: That code does not match the one on the TV.

abort.already_configured: This SceneTV launcher is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the launcher.
abort.link_failed: Pairing with the TV's remote service worked, but the launcher did not accept the link. Update the SceneTV launcher and try again.
abort.reauth_successful: Pairing renewed. The integration has reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Address updated. The integration has reloaded.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different SceneTV launcher.

accessibility_disabled.title: SceneTV accessibility service is off on {name}
accessibility_disabled.description: Key events, the Home button, in-app profile linking and media controls need the SceneTV accessibility service. On the TV, open Settings > Accessibility (on some TVs Device Preferences > Accessibility), select SceneTV and turn it on. This issue clears itself once the TV reports the service as enabled.

overlay_permission_missing.title: SceneTV cannot draw over other apps on {name}
overlay_permission_missing.description: Popup notifications and camera popups only appear over other apps when SceneTV has the "Display over other apps" permission. On the TV, open Settings > Apps > Special app access > Display over other apps and allow SceneTV. This issue clears itself once the TV reports the permission.

init.title: SceneTV options
init.description: Pick the scripts and scenes this TV may run. They appear in the TV's /configure page when you add a Home Assistant action tile, and pressing a tile runs them. Every press also fires android_tv_bridge.action_tile_pressed for your own automations.

data_description.exposed_actions: Only these scripts and scenes can be run from the TV. Removing one stops its tiles from running it.

show_camera.name: Show camera popup
show_camera.description: Show a snapshot popup from a camera configured on SceneTV. Requires a launcher that advertises show_camera.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera id configured in SceneTV camera settings. Stream URLs and credentials stay on the TV.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional popup title. Defaults to the camera name on the TV.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where the popup appears on screen.

duration_ms.name: Duration
duration_ms.description: How long the popup stays visible, in milliseconds (1000 to 600000).

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Take remote focus so OK or Back dismisses the popup.

profiles.name: Profiles
profiles.description: SceneTV profile ids or names that may see this popup. Overrides the camera's popup profiles on the TV.

pause_media.name: Pause media
pause_media.description: Override whether SceneTV pauses playing media while the popup is shown.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12000 because the TV waits for the first snapshot.

create_action_tile.name: Create action tile
create_action_tile.description: Add a Home Assistant action tile to the active SceneTV profile. Pressing it runs the script or scene if it is exposed in the integration options, and always fires android_tv_bridge.action_tile_pressed.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

action.name: Action
action.description: Script or scene the tile runs. Expose it in the integration options too, or the press only fires the event.

action_id.name: Action ID
action_id.description: Custom action id for your own automations, used when no script or scene is picked. Letters, digits, and _ . : - (up to 64).

title.name: Title
title.description: Tile title. Defaults to the script or scene name.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Optional second line on the tile.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Optional image shown on the tile instead of the default icon.

timeout_ms.name: Timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher, in milliseconds.

show_web_popup.name: Show web popup
show_web_popup.description: Show an HTML or URL popup on SceneTV, over any app (the same popup as Show popup). Provide exactly one of html or url.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

html.name: HTML
html.description: Inline HTML to render. Use this or url.

url.name: URL
url.description: Page to load. HTTPS, or HTTP on a private or local host. Use this or html.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where the popup appears on screen. Defaults to center.

duration_ms.name: Duration
duration_ms.description: How long the popup stays visible, in milliseconds (1000 to 600000). Defaults to 5000.

interactive.name: Interactive
interactive.description: Let the remote focus and click inside the popup. Pages can send actions back with SceneTV.postAction, which arrive as android_tv_bridge.web_action events.

allow_javascript.name: Allow JavaScript
allow_javascript.description: Let the HTML run scripts. Defaults to on. Separate from Interactive, which is only about remote focus.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_add.name: Add to queue
queue_add.description: Add one item (uri plus optional fields) or a list of items to the SceneTV media queue.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

uri.name: URI
uri.description: Media link to queue, for example a YouTube or Plex URL. Use this or items.

package.name: Package
package.description: Android package that should open the link. The launcher resolves it when omitted.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title shown in the queue.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Optional subtitle shown in the queue.

items.name: Items
items.description: List of items, each with uri and optional package, title, subtitle and image_url. Use this or uri.

position.name: Position
position.description: end appends; next inserts right after the current item. Defaults to end.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_remove.name: Remove from queue
queue_remove.description: Remove an item from the SceneTV media queue. Removing the current item pauses the queue.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

item_id.name: Queue item ID
item_id.description: Queue item id (qi-...) from the queue state attribute or a queue event.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_move.name: Move queue item
queue_move.description: Move a SceneTV media queue item to a new position.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

item_id.name: Queue item ID
item_id.description: Queue item id (qi-...) from the queue state attribute or a queue event.

to_index.name: To index
to_index.description: New zero-based position in the queue.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_clear.name: Clear queue
queue_clear.description: Remove every item from the SceneTV media queue.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_play.name: Play queue
queue_play.description: Start the SceneTV media queue at an item, or resume it.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

item_id.name: Queue item ID
item_id.description: Optional item to start at. Without it the queue resumes the current item, else the first pending item.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_next.name: Skip to next queue item
queue_next.description: Skip the current SceneTV queue item and launch the next pending one.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

queue_pause.name: Pause queue
queue_pause.description: Stop the SceneTV media queue from advancing. Does not pause the media itself.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

play_voice_clip.name: Play voice clip
play_voice_clip.description: Play a short audio clip on SceneTV in a popup, over any app. Home Assistant only sends the TV a URL; the TV downloads the clip itself. Give exactly one of media_id or url.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: SceneTV config entry to target. Optional when you pick a target or only one launcher is configured.

media_id.name: Media
media_id.description: A Home Assistant media source id (media-source://media_source/local/dinner.mp3, or a TTS media source), or a /local/ or /media/ path. Resolved to a URL the TV can fetch.

url.name: URL
url.description: A direct http(s) URL to an audio file the TV can reach. Use this or media_id.

from.name: From
from.description: Who the clip is from, shown on the popup.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where the popup appears on screen. Defaults to center.

autoplay.name: Autoplay
autoplay.description: Start playing right away. Leave out to use the TV's own setting (autoplay by default); when off, the viewer presses OK to play.

profiles.name: Profiles
profiles.description: Only show the clip when one of these SceneTV profiles is active (names or ids). Leave empty for every profile.

pause_media.name: Pause media
pause_media.description: Pause what is playing while the clip plays and resume afterwards.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to 3 buttons, each {id, label, style, default, data}, same as Show popup. A press fires android_tv_bridge.popup_action.

popup_id.name: Popup ID
popup_id.description: Optional id echoed in popup_shown, voice_clip_finished, popup_action and popup_dismissed events. Generated when left out; use response_variable to read it.

dismiss_label.name: Dismiss label
dismiss_label.description: Label of the built-in Dismiss button. Defaults to Dismiss.

timeout_ms.name: Command timeout
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the launcher to answer, in milliseconds.

trigger_type.popup_action: A popup button was pressed on {entity_name}
trigger_type.tile_pressed: An action tile was pressed on {entity_name}
trigger_type.web_action: A web card or popup sent an action on {entity_name}
trigger_type.tv_input_device_woke: A device on a {entity_name} TV input woke up
